text_block_list.text:
While out with Cesario at the shopping 
district to buy supplies for the Trainer's 
office—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Wah, the lottery raffle...!
choice_data_list: Have you ever done it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, when I was very little. ...That 
rattle really tickles a child's curiosity, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Seeing which ball comes out is kind of 
exciting, but also kind of scary. Fufufu!
choice_data_list: Well then... here you go!

text_block_list.text:
Saying so, I pulled out a lottery ticket. 
I had actually gotten it from my shopping 
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But wasn't that ticket given to you, 
Trainer...?
choice_data_list:
I feel like I'd have better luck drawing 
with a pure heart.

text_block_list.text:
"I leave it to you"—saying that, I hand 
the raffle tickets over to the attendant.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Wanna give it a shot, young lady? Here 
it comes! Put your back into it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Phew. ...Alright. Since it's been 
entrusted to me, let's do this!

Cesario took a deep breath, then spun the 
raffle crank in one swift motion!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Eeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Trainer. How about something like 
this?
choice_data_list: "Ore Mining Experience"?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Apparently, it's one of the local 
specialties. Legend has it that your 
lifespan extends with each one you find.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And for food... maybe here! Trainer looks 
like they'd love this place too...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just looking through the guidebook 
is already so much fun♪
choice_data_list: Yeah! Oh, this looks like fun too!

Yeah! Oh, something like this looks fun 
too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A seafood BBQ with the fish I catch! Wah~ 
I definitely want to do that!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The day we can actually go is still 
a ways off, but let's enjoy these moments 
to the fullest too♪

I nodded firmly and was about to flip 
through the guidebook —when I suddenly 
realized.
choice_data_list:
I know it's a bit late to ask, but are you 
sure you want me to be the one to go with 
you?

I know it's a bit late to ask, but are you 
sure you want me to be the one to go with 
you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ? Yes!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, Trainer... are you sure you're 
okay with me?
choice_data_list: ? I'm perfectly fine, though...
? I'm perfectly fine, though...

text_block_list.text: ...Which means, in other words—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: So that means there's no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Maybe I should get new shoes 
before the trip? Also...

And so, sticky notes gradually accumulated 
day by day in the guidebook she had bought 
and brought home.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Huh! First prize...!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I-I was so surprised... People really do 
win these things, don't they...
choice_data_list: Wh—! ...Even so—
Yeah! ...Even so—

text_block_list.text:
It's huge. Absurdly huge. What kind of 
hamburg steak requires both arms just to 
carry it...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It might be a bit tough to finish all of 
this right now. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Cesario! It's Cesario after all!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I saw that, Cesario! The raffle! The bell 
went *ding-ding-ding*! First prize is 
amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Craft! And—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh, not bad! Though for King, even the 
grand prize above that would be a breeze!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even King-san! Are you two doing voluntary 
training together?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Go do a lap on the outer track 
together, and then...

text_block_list.name: Craft & King
text_block_list.text: (Grumble gurgle...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Man, I'm completely starving~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! I see, you really worked hard, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! If that's the case...—Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I agree!
Yeah, I agree!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...! The juices are 
overflowing like a fountain...! *pant 
pant*!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What... what on earth is with this 
hamburger steak...! The carrots, the meat, 
and the degree of cooking are all 
top-tier! *munch munch*!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I'm so glad. Please don't hold 
back, eat as much as you like♪

Cesario and I sat together, sipping our 
coffee and watching them, when—

text_block_list.name: Craft & King
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait! I really am a total failure! 
...Wait! No, I'm definitely not a total 
failure!"
choice_data_list: Haha! You really ate a lot~
Fufu! You really ate a lot~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Trainer...! ...I'm going to 
go win it back at the raffle right now!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm coming too! I am the King, after 
all—this will be a piece of cake—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Please calm down, both of you. 
There's no need to worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, but still! I can't just let that 
slide...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. In that case, invite me along for 
self-training next time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And when that time comes, let's all eat 
the Deluxe Carrot Hamburgers together, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cesario... Yeah, okay! It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, when that time comes, King 
herself will personally cook for you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you taste a first-rate 'Special 
Deluxe Carrot Hamburger Steak'! O-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: W-Whoa, I hit it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Second prize... For that, it's quite 
extravagant, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
...It really is a literal "mountain" of 
carrots.

...It really is a literal "mountain" of 
carrots.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
W-What should we do? There's no way just 
the two of us could finish all this—

Whoa, that's a huge mountain of 
carrots...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Cesario-chan, Trainer-san! Could this 
be... for the two of you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Buena-san! Hello. That's right, I just 
won it in the lottery over there.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"It was just way more than I expected. I 
was wondering what to do with it all~"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In that case, I know someone who's 
super reliable!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure Cesario knows all about it too, 
though. Fufu!"
choice_data_list: You know Cesario too...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! Her, right...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch, munch*! *Munch, munch, 
munch*!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Spe-san, sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Here is the whole-carrot gratin!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Over here, we have steamed carrot-milk 
bread!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Here you go, bon appétit♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaa~! There's still this much left...! 
Thank you so much! I'm just so happy right 
now...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“Still, um... since we have all this, 
would you all like to eat together with 
us?”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Being alone is a little lonely, you see.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, by all means♪
choice_data_list: Then, don't mind if I do.

text_block_list.text:
And so, Cesario finished off every single 
one of the mountain of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
One stick... Hmm. That's an awkwardly 
small amount, actually.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! That's it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, have you decided on dinner for 
tonight?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: If you haven't decided yet—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. The nikujaga ended up being 
mostly carrots.
choice_data_list:
I'm totally fine. But were you okay with 
that?

I'm totally fine. But were you okay with 
that?

text_block_list.text:
Even though Cesario won the carrots, I 
ended up eating them all myself...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, of course!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Because whenever you're busy, you tend 
to neglect your meals."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So please eat up and get plenty of 
nourishment today.
choice_data_list: …Thanks as always.
…Thank you as always!

text_block_list.text:
The nikujaga Cesario made for me kept my 
body and soul warm for quite some time 
after.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... What a shame. I'm sorry, after 
you went out of your way to entrust this 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Still, pocket tissues are always 
appreciated. They tend to disappear so 
quickly.
choice_data_list:
When you're playing with kids, it just 
happens.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But for little kids, it's better if 
they're full of energy like that.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I tried putting a positive spin 
on it, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Just between you and me... I was a little 
frustrated.
